programme.title: Ben Fogle: Return to the Wild 2
programme.desc: Traveler Ben Fogle revisits the participants of the "Life in the Wasteland" program.These people have in common the fact that years ago they decided to abandon their previous existence in favor of living in the bosom of nature, often in a remote area and in extremely harsh conditions.Ben will check, among others:what happened to a former war correspondent who became a grizzly bear expert.He will also revisit a former financier who is now living the life of Tarzan in a swampy area in Georgia.The presenter will find out whether these people are satisfied with their choices.

programme.title: Planet Earth III
programme.desc: The third part of the nature documentary, produced over almost five years, concludes the trilogy almost two decades after the first series was broadcast.Its creators used pioneering film technologies, including:light drones, super-fast cameras and remotely controlled deep-sea submarines.In eight episodes, viewers will visit the most remote jungles, the darkest ocean depths, the world's largest caves and the hottest deserts and steppes.They will learn the story about nature's will to survive and the adaptive abilities of various species.The Earth is at a tipping point and changes in the natural world are felt in every ecosystem and affect numerous creatures.The series highlights the growing need to protect and restore nature.In the last episode, viewers will meet inspiring people from various corners of the world who are the face of change and saving the Earth.They are committed to risking their lives to protect the planet.Sir David Attenborough will guide the series.

programme.title: Attenborough's Wonder of Eggs
programme.desc: Bird eggs nurture new life, protecting it from the outside world while allowing it to breathe.They are strong enough not to break under the full weight of the incubating parent, and fragile enough for the chick to escape.From creation to hatching, Sir David Attenborough reveals the rich process behind these natural wonders.Along the way, he shares stories about the eggs of a whole range of birds - from swans and their aquatic world, to the cliffs where the common guillemot lives and lays its eggs.

programme.title: Life Below Zero
programme.desc: Alaska has extremely harsh climatic conditions.Temperatures there regularly drop to life-threatening levels.Despite this, the region is inhabited by people.The tenth season of the program presents the everyday adventures of the inhabitants of four households from different parts of the Alaskan wilderness.Their lives focus primarily on hunting and careful preparations for and struggles with the long and frosty winter.Viewers will see, among others:Agnes Hailstone, who with her daughters tries to hunt caribou while her husband is away.

programme.title: Secrets of the Jurassic Dinosaurs
programme.desc: An international team of paleontologists is conducting excavations in the Midwestern region of the United States.The Mission Jurassic team working in Wyoming is trying to solve the mystery of the mass dinosaur graveyard discovered there.Scientists found, among other things, over 600 bones, rare plants and dinosaur footprints.They try to answer the question: why so many creatures died here and how it is possible that their remains have survived for over 100 million years.The creators of the documentary, which took more than four years to produce, show one of the most spectacular excavations in the world.
